item.title: Telecommunications Policy in Transition: Infrastructure, Platforms, Media and AI
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores telecommunications policy during a period of significant transformation. The call invites research addressing how policy frameworks are evolving across infrastructure development, platform regulation, media integration, and the integration of artificial intelligence technologies into telecommunications systems.

Appel publié par Telecommunications Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Telecommunications policy
  • Infrastructure
  • Platforms
  • Media
  • Artificial intelligence
